name: Camille Moreau
headline: Senior Product Manager | Product Strategy & Growth
summary: Senior Product Manager with 9 years of experience driving product strategy, growth, and data-informed decision-making across B2B SaaS and marketplace platforms. Skilled at leading cross-functional teams, running rigorous A/B tests, and translating complex data into actionable roadmaps. Proven track record of launching features that improve retention and revenue.

responsibilities: Define and own product strategy for core marketplace platform serving 500k+ monthly users
Lead A/B testing program across onboarding and checkout flows to improve conversion rates
Collaborate with engineering, design, and data science teams to prioritize quarterly roadmap
Analyze user behavior data using SQL to identify growth opportunities
Present quarterly business reviews to executive leadership
Managed product lifecycle for B2B SaaS analytics dashboard
Conducted user interviews and translated findings into feature specifications
Ran A/B tests on pricing page to optimize sign-up conversion
Partnered with sales and customer success to gather product feedback
Maintained product backlog and coordinated sprint planning with engineering
Supported senior PMs in defining requirements for mobile application features
Performed competitive analysis and market research to inform product decisions
Assisted in writing user stories and acceptance criteria for development team
Tracked key product metrics and prepared weekly performance reports
